cards.title: Adverb position
cards.body: Most mid-sentence adverbs: before main verb, after be.
cards.body_cz: Většina: před hlavním slovesem, po be.
points: always · usually · often · never · also · still · already
Not: I drink always coffee (this unit)

cards.title: like … very much
cards.body: like + object + very much (end). Not: I like very much this city.
cards.body_cz: like + předmět + very much na konci. Ne: like very much this…

cards.title: too / either / also
points: I like coffee too. · I don't like coffee either.

cards.title: Manner adverbs
points: usually after the verb: drive carefully

cards.title: Frequency review
points: Same position rule as A1 frequency pack

cards.title: Practice focus
points: Check: before verb or after be?

cards.title: Remember
points: before verb / after be: always, also, still, already
cards.body_cz: před slovesem / po be · too/either na konci
